securityReporting.approach: SECURITY.md should state that there are no supported production releases yet, ask reporters not to file public issues for vulnerabilities, and direct reports to GitHub private vulnerability reporting once the repository enables it. Until then, use a repository-owner-maintained placeholder contact rather than personal data.
